findings.message: The entry params criadasPorMim, atribuidasAMim, status, somenteDevolvidas, page and termo have effects (filter:tarefasLista / filter:tarefaForm) but no state in the definition. Added persisted filter states with the param names; they are changed through minhasTarefas({ ... }, page, append) and buscarResponsaveis(termo).

The param tarefaId selects tarefaDetalhe but no member selects it. Added selectTarefa(tarefaId | null), which publishes selectedTarefa and opens the record through the tarefaAberta query (kept in `tarefa`); a null clears the selection.

The commands salvarNovaTarefa, salvarEdicaoTarefa and devolverComMotivo have fields the person types but no <command>.input state. Added salvarNovaTarefaDraft (with the idempotency key generated by crypto.randomUUID and prefilled from the params listaId/responsavelId), salvarEdicaoTarefaDraft (filled from the open task) and devolverComMotivoDraft, with their setters, plus limparSalvarNovaTarefaDraft and restaurarSalvarEdicaoTarefaDraft.

Commands return tarefa and resumo with no state as source. Applied: tarefa, selectedTarefa and the edit draft redrawn; the row upserted by id in tarefas (removed when it no longer matches the status/somenteDevolvidas filter; a new row is inserted first). The list is not re-sorted by prazo and its page/hasMore are not recomputed after an insert, edit or removal.
salvarNovaTarefa requires criadorId as the session member, but no state or route gives that id to the page; it is sent empty so the backend fills it from the session.
